strings.item.grimoire_clerical.name: Spatial Misfiling and You
strings.item.grimoire_clerical.description: A grimoire from the Bellwether Library's Restricted Section, decades overdue. Return it to Fenwick, who will let you copy Clerical Error into your spellbook.
strings.book.grimoire_clerical.text:
SPATIAL MISFILING AND YOU
(Bureau Internal Circular 9-Q)

Should an object (or clerk) be filed in the wrong place, the universe will, in a small number of cases, simply accept the new location as correct. This circular explains how to make that happen ON PURPOSE.

Step one: fill in Form 9-Q in your head. Step two: believe it. Step three: you are now somewhere else.

Stamped in red across the cover: FILED UNDER Q. Underneath, in Oakhaven's neat hand: "Q for 'Quite Lost'. Note to self: tell nobody."

[The spell inside is locked behind a library binding-charm. Fenwick can unlock it.]
strings.item.cinderglass_dagger.name: Cinderglass Dagger
strings.item.cinderglass_dagger.description: Volcanic glass, still warm. Sets things on fire, and keeps them that way. Pairs dangerously well with anything that chills.
strings.item.rimecaller_mace.name: Rimecaller Mace
strings.item.rimecaller_mace.description: A mace with a head of blue ice that never melts. Every few hits, the target slows. Three chills and it's a statue.
strings.item.storm_stamp.name: The Storm-Clerk's Stamp
strings.item.storm_stamp.description: A brass Bureau stamp that reads APPROVED in lightning. Shatters and Overloads hit 35% harder, and status effects land a little more often.
strings.item.library_card.name: Fenwick's Library Card (Lifetime, Laminated)
strings.item.library_card.description: Card number 0000001. There has never been a card 0000001 before. +1 Intellect, status effects last 30% longer, spells cost 6% less. All fines waived. All of them. Forever.
strings.bark.fenwick.overdue_done: Six for six. The Restricted Section is complete. I may frame the returns ledger.
strings.synergy.storm_clerk.name: Thermal Paperwork
strings.synergy.storm_clerk.desc: Elemental 14 + Illusion 8. You have learned to file fire, frost and lightning in the right order. Statuses last 25% longer; Shatter and Overload hit 25% harder.
strings.dlg.overdue.fenwick.od_start:
Fenwick goes very still. Then he reaches under the desk and brings out a ledger bound in black, with a small brass lock and the words RESTRICTED SECTION: OUTSTANDING on the cover.

FENWICK: "Since you ask." He unlocks it with a key he wears round his neck. "Six grimoires. Six borrowers. A combined total of two hundred and four years overdue. The fines alone could rebuild the east wing. Twice."

"These are not cookbooks. These are SPELLBOOKS. Real ones. Collegium originals. Every one of them holds a working spell under a binding-charm, which I alone can open."

He slides the ledger across.

"Bring them back, and I will let you copy every spell into your own book while I stamp them in. That is not policy. That is desperation."
strings.dlg.overdue.fenwick.od_who:
FENWICK (running a finger down the ledger): "'On Cold Shoulders'. Lord Ashgrave, Hollowmere Manor. Borrowed to 'brood more effectively'. He did not need help."

"'Chain of Command'. Professor Pickering, Saltmere. Borrowed for 'research'. Seven extension requests, all written in a hand that gets worse each time."

"'The Standing Ovation'. Madame Odette. Signed out 'for one night only'. Nine years ago."

"'Slow Burn'. Mother Brine, of the Drowned Lantern. I'm told it's under a pot."

"'[REDACTED]'. Brother Aldous. He says he never borrowed it. The ledger says otherwise. The ledger does not lie."

"And 'Spatial Misfiling and You'." He hesitates. "Clerk Oakhaven. Who has never once returned a book late in his life. Which is why I find this one so... troubling."
strings.dlg.overdue.fenwick.od_return: FENWICK (stamp raised, eyes shining): "Yes? YES? Which ones?"
strings.dlg.overdue.fenwick.od_r0: FENWICK: "It's... sparkling." He holds it at arm's length. "There is glitter in the spine. There is glitter in the GUTTER of every page. I am going to be finding glitter in this library until I die." Stamp. "Copy it quickly. Cold Shoulder: it's in the ring, on page nine."
strings.dlg.overdue.fenwick.od_r1: FENWICK reads the margins and goes pale. "'must ask Fenwick for an extension'. Forty-one times. On one page." He closes it gently. "Poor man. Stamp. Copy it. Chain of Command. Mind the jumps."
strings.dlg.overdue.fenwick.od_r2: FENWICK: "'For one night only'." Stamp. "Nine years. I suppose it was a long night." A pause. "Did she say anything about me?" Another pause. "Never mind. Standing Ovation. Copy it. Don't cast it in here."
strings.dlg.overdue.fenwick.od_r3: FENWICK sniffs it. "Chowder." Sniffs again. "Good chowder, admittedly." Stamp. "Slow Burn. Copy it. Chapter Six is the spell. Chapter Four is, apparently, a fish stew."
strings.dlg.overdue.fenwick.od_r4: FENWICK opens it, flicks through, and turns it upside down. "It's ALL redacted. Every page. He blacked out his own copy of the book about blacking things out." He looks at the ceiling. "Somehow the spell still works. [REDACTED]. Copy it. I can't read it, but you can."
strings.dlg.overdue.fenwick.od_r5: FENWICK holds it for a long moment. "Filed under Q. Oakhaven filed it under Q." He sits down. "Nineteen years, never late, not once, and he misfiled his OWN library book." Something like a smile. "I think I like him more now. Clerical Error. Copy it."
strings.dlg.overdue.fenwick.od_done:
Fenwick closes the black ledger. He turns the key in its little brass lock. Then, for the first time in your acquaintance, he takes the key off from round his neck and drops it in a drawer.

FENWICK: "Two hundred and four years. Six books. Every one back on its shelf." His voice catches slightly. "Do you know what that is? That's a complete collection. I have never in my life had a complete collection."

He takes a card from his breast pocket, laminated, with a number embossed in gold: 0000001.

"Lifetime membership. All fines waived. Every fine. Including the ones you haven't incurred yet." He presses it into your hand. "Including the Restricted Section. Go anywhere. Read anything." Then, quickly: "Within reason. Shh."
strings.dlg.overdue.ash.t: "Fenwick wants 'On Cold Shoulders' back, my lord."
strings.dlg.overdue.ash.od_ash:
Ashgrave turns from the window with infinite slowness.

ASHGRAVE: "'On Cold Shoulders'. Yes. It speaks to me. It is the only book that has ever understood me." He clutches it to his chest. "I cannot give it up. Unless..."

"Unless someone were to tell me, honestly, what they thought of my poetry."
strings.dlg.overdue.ash.od_ash.c1: "Honestly? It's quite bad. But you clearly mean every word, and that counts."
strings.dlg.overdue.ash.od_ash_lie: ASHGRAVE (glittering, overcome): "Magnificent. MAGNIFICENT." He hands you the book without looking at it. "Take it. I no longer need a guide. I have a fan."
strings.dlg.overdue.ash.od_ash_caught: ASHGRAVE: "You're lying. I can always tell. I've been lied to by the finest." He sighs, tragically, and hands it over anyway. "Take it. Take everything. Nobody understands me."
strings.dlg.overdue.ash.od_ash_true:
Ashgrave stares at you. Nobody has ever said that to him before.

ASHGRAVE (very quietly): "...Thank you." He hands you the book, and then, after a moment, a second, slimmer one bound in red velvet. "This one is mine. Not the library's. It's... a little more personal. For when you need more life than you have."

"I'm going to write a poem about this. It will be very bad. I will mean every word."
strings.dlg.overdue.pick.t: "Professor, the library needs 'Chain of Command' back."
strings.dlg.overdue.pick.od_pick:
Pickering produces the book from inside his coat, where it has clearly lived for some time.

PICKERING: "Ah. Yes. I was going to ask for an extension." He pats it. "The lightning passes down the line, you see, just like the tide-bells passed the count. Fascinating parallel. Possibly a paper." He hands it over reluctantly. "Tell Fenwick... tell him I'm sorry about the margins."
strings.dlg.overdue.odette.t: "Madame, 'The Standing Ovation' is nine years overdue."
strings.dlg.overdue.odette.od_odette:
ODETTE (one gloved hand to her heart): "Nine YEARS? Darling, I borrowed it for one night only!"

She produces it from somewhere inside the fur stole.

ODETTE: "It was a very long night. The understudy was a disaster. I needed something to bring the house down, and it DID, literally, the balcony is still being repaired." She hands it over with a flourish. "Tell Fenwick he's welcome at any opening night. Front row. Bring earplugs."
strings.dlg.overdue.brine.t: "Mother Brine, the library wants 'Slow Burn' back."
strings.dlg.overdue.brine.od_brine:
Mother Brine lifts a large pot of chowder off the bar. Underneath, steaming gently, is a book.

BRINE: "Keeps it warm. Eleven years. Best chowder on the coast and I'll thank you not to ask why."

She hands it over, then catches your arm. "Chapter Four's a fish stew. Chapter Six is the spell. Do NOT get them mixed up."
strings.dlg.overdue.aldous.od_aldous:
BROTHER ALDOUS: "I have never borrowed any such book."

You wait.

BROTHER ALDOUS: "...It was for the hymn book. Some of the old verses were very rude. 'O Lord, Thy Bounteous Melons'. I couldn't have children singing that." He produces a book, every page solid black. "I may have got carried away. I redacted the instructions as well. And the cover. And the index." He hands it over. "The spell still works. I checked. On the melons verse."
strings.dlg.overdue.oak.t: "Oakhaven, Fenwick has you down for 'Spatial Misfiling and You'."
strings.dlg.overdue.oak.od_oak:
Oakhaven freezes with his pen in mid-air.

OAKHAVEN: "That is not possible. I have never been late with a library book. Nineteen years. Not one day." He goes to his filing cabinet, opens the drawer marked S, closes it, opens the drawer marked M, closes it, stands very still for a long time, and opens the drawer marked Q.

The book is there.

OAKHAVEN (in a very small voice): "Q for 'Quite Lost'." He hands it to you as if it were radioactive. "Please tell Fenwick I'm sorry. Please tell nobody else. Please."
strings.quest.overdue.title: Overdue: The Restricted Section
strings.quest.overdue.summary: Six Collegium spellbooks, six borrowers, two hundred and four years overdue. Fenwick will let you copy each spell when you bring it back.
strings.quest.overdue.stage0: Recover the six overdue grimoires (Ashgrave, Pickering, Odette, Mother Brine, Brother Aldous, Oakhaven) and return them to Fenwick.
strings.quest.overdue.journal0: Fenwick's black ledger: 'On Cold Shoulders' (Ashgrave), 'Chain of Command' (Pickering), 'The Standing Ovation' (Odette), 'Slow Burn' (Mother Brine), '[REDACTED]' (Brother Aldous) and 'Spatial Misfiling and You' (Oakhaven, apparently). Each one I return, I can copy.
strings.quest.overdue.stage100: Completed: the Restricted Section is complete.
strings.quest.overdue.journal100: Six books, all back on the shelf. Fenwick took the key off from round his neck. I have library card number 0000001, and no fines, ever.
strings.tip.29: Chill something three times and it freezes. Set fire to something frozen and it shatters. Fenwick does not approve of this, but he did write it down.
strings.tip.30: Lightning on a burning foe causes an Overload. Lightning on a burning library causes a lifetime ban.

strings.dlg.aldous.respec.t: "Brother, I'd like to rethink some choices I've made."
strings.dlg.aldous.respec:
Brother Aldous folds his hands.

"The Rite of Second Thoughts. Very old. Very holy. Mostly paperwork."

"You kneel. You reflect. You think about every path you've chosen, the swords you chose instead of shields, the fire you chose instead of frost, and the Dawn gently says: 'Are you SURE?' And then you may choose again. Every perk you hold returns to you, to be chosen anew."

"There is a suggested donation of fifty gold. The Dawn is not mercenary. The roof, however, leaks."
strings.dlg.aldous.respec.c0: Donate 50 gold and kneel. (Choose all your perks again.)
strings.dlg.aldous.respec_done:
You kneel. The candles flicker. Somewhere, very faintly, a choir sings a single questioning note: "Are you SURE?"

You stand, lighter. Every perk you held is yours to choose again.

BROTHER ALDOUS: "The Dawn bless your new choices. And your old ones, which were also fine. Mostly."
strings.tip.31: Perks: every few skill levels you choose one of two. Brother Aldous will let you choose again, for a small donation to the roof.
strings.spell.bewilder.name: Bewilder
strings.spell.bewilder.desc: The target forgets which way is up, who it was fighting, and what a 'you' is. It wanders about and swings at whatever's nearest, friend or foe.
strings.spell.sudden_friendship.name: Sudden Friendship
strings.spell.sudden_friendship.desc: For fourteen seconds, the target thinks you are the best person it has ever met, and fights anything that disagrees. Hitting your new friend ends the friendship. Bosses have trust issues.
strings.spell.unauthorised_entry.name: Unauthorised Entry
strings.spell.unauthorised_entry.desc: The lock you are looking at is persuaded that it was never locked in the first place. Works on locks up to a difficulty that grows with your Illusion. Leaves no lockpicks broken and no paperwork filed.
strings.spell.borrowed_vitality.name: Borrowed Vitality
strings.spell.borrowed_vitality.desc: For twenty-five seconds, every blow you land gives a little of their life to you. Lord Ashgrave says it's 'not like that'. It's exactly like that.
strings.spell.late_for_appointment.name: Late for an Appointment
strings.spell.late_for_appointment.desc: The universal panic of being late, bottled. You move 35% faster for eighteen seconds. Your heart rate does too.
strings.spell.paper_storm.name: Paper Storm
strings.spell.paper_storm.desc: A whirlwind of razor-edged Bureau forms bursts out around you. Everything nearby takes a thousand paper cuts and bleeds. Bleeding stacks up to three times.
strings.item.tome_bewilder.name: Tome: Bewilder: A Primer in Confusion
strings.item.tome_bewilder.description: Reading it teaches the spell (and the tome crumbles).
strings.book.tome_bewilder.text:
Chapter One: Where Am I?
Chapter Two: Who Are You?
Chapter Three: Why Is That Wolf Hitting The Other Wolf?

The author's note: "I wrote this book in a single sitting and have no memory of doing so."
strings.item.tome_friendship.name: Tome: Sudden Friendship (Abridged)
strings.item.tome_friendship.description: Reading it teaches the spell (and the tome crumbles).
strings.book.tome_friendship.text:
"Every monster is merely a friend you have not yet hexed."

The illustrations show a smiling wizard, a grinning troll, and the troll later eating a different troll. The caption reads: TEAMWORK.
strings.item.tome_entry.name: Tome: Unauthorised Entry: The Lawyer's Edition
strings.item.tome_entry.description: Reading it teaches the spell (and the tome crumbles).
strings.book.tome_entry.text:
Section 1. A lock is a contract between a door and a frame.
Section 2. Contracts can be voided.
Section 3. Here's how.

Stamped on every page: NOT FOR USE ON BUREAU PREMISES. Someone has crossed out NOT.
strings.item.tome_vitality.name: Tome: Borrowed Vitality
strings.item.tome_vitality.description: Reading it teaches the spell (and the tome crumbles).
strings.book.tome_vitality.text: A slim, elegant volume bound in red velvet. The handwritten dedication reads: "For when you need a little more life than you have. -A." It smells faintly of roses and something metallic.
strings.item.tome_late.name: Tome: Late for an Appointment
strings.item.tome_late.description: Reading it teaches the spell (and the tome crumbles).
strings.book.tome_late.text: This book is very short because the author did not have time to finish it. The spell is on page one. Page two just says "SORRY SORRY SORRY".
strings.item.tome_paper.name: Tome: Paper Storm: A Bureau Self-Defence Manual
strings.item.tome_paper.description: Reading it teaches the spell (and the tome crumbles).
strings.book.tome_paper.text:
"Clerks are often told they are harmless. This manual exists to correct that impression."

The pages have unusually sharp edges. Handle with care.
strings.item.wand_sparks.name: Wand of Sparks
strings.item.wand_sparks.description: A copper rod that buzzes in your hand. Each charge casts Chain of Command without mana. The number on the stack is the charges left. Put it on a quick slot.
strings.item.wand_frost.name: Wand of Frost
strings.item.wand_frost.description: Rimed with ice at the tip. Each charge fires a Frost Lance. The number on the stack is the charges left. Put it on a quick slot.
strings.item.wand_bewilder.name: Wand of Bewilderment
strings.item.wand_bewilder.description: Twisted like a question mark. Each charge casts Bewilder. The number on the stack is the charges left. Put it on a quick slot.
strings.item.wand_friendship.name: Wand of Sudden Friendship
strings.item.wand_friendship.description: Pink, with a little bow on it. Deeply unsettling. Each charge casts Sudden Friendship. The number on the stack is the charges left. Put it on a quick slot.
strings.item.wand_entry.name: Wand of Unauthorised Entry
strings.item.wand_entry.description: Shaped like a key, if a key were also a crowbar. Each charge casts Unauthorised Entry. The number on the stack is the charges left. Put it on a quick slot.
strings.item.serrated_cleaver.name: Serrated Cleaver
strings.item.serrated_cleaver.description: A butcher's cleaver with a saw-tooth back, 'confiscated' from the Hollowmere kitchens. Opens wounds that keep on giving. Bleeding stacks three times.
strings.item.thornbow.name: Thornbow
strings.item.thornbow.description: A bow grown, not carved, from a thornbush in the Whistling Wood. The arrows come out barbed. Things it hits bleed.
strings.item.inconvenient_sword.name: The Sword of Mild Inconvenience
strings.item.inconvenient_sword.description: Enchanted by a wizard with a grudge and a short attention span. Sometimes the person it hits forgets what they were doing. Sometimes so do you. (Only them, actually. Probably.)
strings.tip.32: Wands are free spells. The number on the stack is how many charges are left. Wands go in quick slots too.
strings.tip.33: A confused wolf will happily bite another wolf. A charmed wolf will do it on purpose.
